The freeze is self-verifying: 3_1.mjs T1 recomputes all four digests against the accepted bytes.
green_summary.3.1.b_case_schema_and_journey_runner: tools/verify/delivery-case-schema.json: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 subset) for case definitions — schemaVersion, scenario id pattern, acceptanceIds, caseModule, sourceBinding, actions[] (type=spawn|readState|inspect; command required for spawn, path for readState/inspect, expected always; if/then enforcement), evidence.artifacts, and the four verdictSemantics keys. tools/verify/delivery-journey.mjs: test action/observer adapter ONLY (header-declared and structurally enforced — no phase, no DAG, no retries, no job lease, no auto-recovery). Loads the case plan (default verification-case-plan.json or --case-plan), the pilot contract machine block (--pilot-contract), synthesizes canonical actions (spawn `node --test <caseModule>` + readState of the persisted TAP + inspect git HEAD) or takes an explicit schema-validated --case-definition, executes each action exactly once, parses TAP summaries/points, enforces the declared evidence artifacts exist on disk, writes case-definition.json/pilot-baseline.json/action-N-stdout.txt/action-N-stderr.txt/verdict.json into --evidence-dir, and emits the verdict JSON (--json stdout identical to verdict.json). CLI compatible verbatim with the execution-contract check commands: --scenario <ID> --profile managed-pilot --evidence-dir .whitebox/delivery-foundation/<ID> --json. Exit contract: 0=PASS; 1=invalid input (bad args, unreadable explicit override paths); 2=FAIL and every NOT-EXERCISED/NOT-APPLICABLE (unregistered scenario, missing case module/definition/schema, unregistered profile, baseline-missing with list, frozen-baseline-drift, target-scenario-skipped, no-effective-execution incl. all-skip). Skips are never converted into passes; PASS requires pass>0 and fail==0 and no failed action. Strips NODE_TEST_CONTEXT on spawns (repo convention from 2_1.mjs/2_2.mjs) so nested node --test children really run; no-retry proven by an invocation-counter fixture (exactly one execution).

blockers_or_questions: .whitebox/ is not in .gitignore, so the verbatim V_* check commands leave untracked evidence dirs in the repo. This worker does not own .gitignore; the controller/VERIFY task should decide (add .whitebox/ or treat as evidence to commit). The untracked .whitebox output from local verification runs was removed to keep the tree clean; commands regenerate it.

Exit-code nuance: the task directive requires exit 2 (structured UNVERIFIED) for missing case definition/prerequisites; execution-contract cli_contract phrases 1=invalid input/prerequisite. Implemented: 1 only for malformed arguments and unreadable explicit override paths; every missing case/prerequisite/baseline/environment path exits 2 as UNVERIFIED. All refusal paths are nonzero, satisfying the frozen V_* expected text ('依赖缺失退出非零/UNVERIFIED，不得跳过判PASS').
